reason: The submission selects one finite source-terminal congestion candidate for Phase 5 on the same [144a] handoff pattern. Its three-edge test is the weakest cardinality case needed after the registered Q>=2 bound: a star then has four distinct demands and a matching has six, so the at-most-three fixed-terminal fibre excludes an all-root route family while allowing root-ending routes to remain in a mixed family. The candidate also gives a bounded source-edge-to-terminal map and a distinct-terminal count. By contrast, the route-union Menger linkage has no distinct-source-edge assignment and its cut need not cut G; the existing two-edge owner already produces its envelope. The note claims neither a consumer for those outcomes nor route-edge, centre-arm, or envelope capacity, and it grants no construction, move credit, cap, estimate, or closure.
